question: Should OpenClaw now make imsg 0.11.1 a hard iMessage startup floor and require `openclaw doctor --fix` for existing `coalesceSameSenderDms` configurations?
rationale: This intentionally removes a shipped fallback, invalidates persisted configuration until migration, and can stop iMessage delivery for older dependency installations; tests cannot decide whether that upgrade boundary is acceptable.

options.title: Adopt The New Floor
options.body: Accept imsg 0.11.1 as the supported minimum and merge after current-head live delivery and doctor proof is added.

options.title: Preserve Compatibility Longer
options.body: Keep the existing OpenClaw fallback until maintainers choose a later release window or a less disruptive upgrade path.

options.title: Pause The Cleanup
options.body: Leave the linked issue and this PR open until the dependency-floor and migration timing have explicit owner approval.

recommendation.title: Adopt The New Floor
recommendation.body: Accept imsg 0.11.1 as the supported minimum and merge after current-head live delivery and doctor proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate for the combined OpenClaw iMessage compatibility and imsg release-floor decision.
